_comment: Bin-resolution arm of the SimCC experiment. Single-variable change from lizard_simcc.json: simcc_upsample 4 -> 8, i.e. 1024 bins per axis = 0.5 canvas px per bin, with simcc_decode_radius doubled (16 bins) so the decode WINDOW covers the same physical +/-8px and resolution is the only thing that changes. simcc_sigma is also doubled (12 bins) to hold the target's physical width at 6px -- leaving it at 6 bins would simultaneously halve the target width and confound the comparison. Purpose: if SimCC beats the heatmap control but up8 is flat against up4, the win came from escaping the input/4 grid and 1px bins are already enough; if up8 keeps improving, localization precision is still the binding constraint and the next lever is backbone output stride, not bin count.
